# Kolding Børne- og Ungeafdeling

Kolding Børne- og Ungeafdeling is a pediatric and adolescent department in the Danish healthcare system that participates in the DANIBD registry, which monitors diagnostic assessment practices for newly diagnosed inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) patients across Danish hospitals and regions. The department has achieved 87% compliance with indicator 1b—measuring complete diagnostic evaluation (gastroscopy, colonoscopy, and MR imaging or capsule endoscopy) in children and young people—which exceeds the national development target of 80% [^src1].

Indicator 1b is one of two key metrics tracked in the DANIBD registry's assessment framework. While indicator 1a focuses on colonoscopy evaluation of adults and has met the national target of 79%, indicator 1b addresses the more demanding requirement of complete diagnostic workup in the pediatric population. Nationally, only 69% of pediatric IBD patients meet the full diagnostic standard, making Kolding Børne- og Ungeafdeling's performance a notable outlier [^src1]. The registry documents regional and departmental variation in compliance, analyzes barriers to complete evaluation, and plans to reassess this indicator at the next audit scheduled for 2026 [^src1].
